facts.fact: The Ministry of Education states SIGE, the national school-management system, was created by the state company NOSi in partnership with the Ministry, and covers all 43 secondary and 395 basic schools.
SIGE, created by NOSi with the Ministry of Education, was piloted in 2009, reached all 43 secondary schools in July 2018 and all 395 basic schools in February 2019 (completion of national rollout).

systems.owner: Ministry of Education; built by NOSi
